title: Verified IEC 61850 buffered SOE replay and safer P9 reporting
titleId: Replay SOE buffer IEC 61850 terverifikasi dan reporting P9 lebih andal
summary: ARSAS 1.6.44 Windows IEC 61850 engineering tester adds verified SG7_BCU BRCB historical replay classification in a single Event column, retained report EntryID/TimeOfEntry diagnostics and guarded operator-only Browser PurgeBuf. Application stable denotes a tested software package, not IEC 61850 certification or proof of lossless SOE.
summaryId: ARSAS 1.6.44 tester engineering IEC 61850 Windows kini mengklasifikasikan replay historis BRCB yang teruji pada SG7_BCU melalui satu kolom Event, menjaga diagnostik EntryID/TimeOfEntry dan PurgeBuf manual yang dibatasi izin operator. Stable adalah rilis software yang diuji, bukan sertifikasi IEC 61850 atau bukti seluruh SOE tanpa kehilangan.
highlights: One clear SOE Event label: Buffer event when historical BRCB replay evidence qualifies; Data change, Integrity and GI remain distinct causes.
Six-byte IEC MMS BinaryTime TimeOfEntry support validated with SG7_BCU raw report bytes; UTC-Time quality checks remain strict.
Preserves BRCB buffer history: ARSAS never automatically purges IED buffers. An explicit IED Browser PurgeBuf write is confirmation-gated and identity-checked.
Safer reconnect and duplicate EntryID handling with bounded per-RCB evidence; repeated DataSet members reuse the accepted frame's cursor.
Existing 77/77 SG7_BCU live values, 4/4 routed RCB traffic and operator-authorized control testing preserved.
highlightsId: Kolom Event SOE sederhana: Buffer event untuk replay BRCB historis yang memenuhi bukti; Data change, Integrity, dan GI tetap terpisah.
TimeOfEntry IEC MMS BinaryTime enam-byte didukung dengan validasi raw report SG7_BCU; pemeriksaan kualitas UTC-Time tetap ketat.
Riwayat buffer BRCB dijaga: ARSAS tidak pernah melakukan purge otomatis. Write PurgeBuf di IED Browser hanya setelah konfirmasi operator dan validasi identitas.
Reconnect dan duplikasi EntryID lebih aman dengan bukti per-RCB terbatas; member DataSet berulang menggunakan hasil penerimaan frame yang sama.
77/77 nilai SG7_BCU, 4/4 jalur RCB, dan pengujian kontrol atas izin operator tetap dipertahankan.
improvements: SG7_BCU field diagnostic 21 Nov 2026: 77/77 visible live points, four exact routed BRCBs, 337 decoded report frames; A01/B01 replay triage Buffer and Event Log displays Buffer event.
P9 regression tests preserve original cause versus buffered delivery, reject repeated accepted EntryID as new replay, and protect the single Event label and conservative unknown fallback.
Optimized accepted report-cursor path: a frame containing many DataSet members needs one wire TimeOfEntry/cursor acceptance per contiguous frame identity, without adding MMS reads or queues.
Windows release source, native bridge, portable and installer must match the exact approved main SHA and carry verified checksums, provenance and SPDX SBOM.
improvementsId: Diagnostik lapangan SG7_BCU 21 November 2026: 77/77 nilai terlihat, empat BRCB menerima report, 337 frame didekode; replay A01/B01 terklasifikasi Buffer dan kolom Event menampilkan Buffer event.
Tes regresi P9 memisahkan cause asli dari pengiriman buffer, menolak EntryID yang sudah diterima agar tidak dianggap replay baru, dan menjaga label Event sederhana serta fallback konservatif.
Jalur penerimaan cursor report dioptimasi: satu frame berisi banyak member DataSet hanya membutuhkan satu penerimaan TimeOfEntry/cursor per identitas frame berurutan, tanpa tambahan MMS atau antrean.
Sumber rilis Windows, native bridge, portable dan installer wajib cocok dengan SHA main yang disetujui, checksum, provenance dan SPDX SBOM terverifikasi.
knownLimitations: The SG7_BCU 21 Nov 2026 diagnostic reported four IED BufOvfl notices and 28 SqNum discontinuities across 337 frames. These are not proven lost SOEs; lossless replay completeness is NOT certified.

SG7_BCU replay field observation applied to the preceding P9 core; the final performance/deduplication change is regression-tested but still requires exact-build independent device retest. Some test endpoints may be local simulators.
Six-byte IEC MMS BinaryTime does not carry a clock quality flag; the 2-minute historical guard is a conservative classification, not independently certified IED time synchronization.
The ARIEC61850 engine remains pinned to a code-trial revision (PR #192). Physical multi-vendor R7/R10 acceptance and trusted SCL/IID parity are not claimed by software stable.
Windows x64 only; binaries are not commercially Authenticode-signed. Active IED controls and manual PurgeBuf require explicit authorization and safe FAT procedures.
knownLimitationsId: Diagnostik SG7_BCU 21 November 2026 mencatat empat indikator BufOvfl dan 28 diskontinuitas SqNum dari 337 frame. Ini bukan bukti event hilang; kelengkapan SOE buffer tanpa kehilangan BELUM tersertifikasi.

Pengujian lapangan replay SG7_BCU memakai inti P9 sebelumnya; optimasi/deduplikasi terbaru telah lolos regresi tetapi masih memerlukan retest pada build identik. Sebagian endpoint uji dapat berupa simulator lokal.
IEC MMS BinaryTime enam-byte tidak membawa flag kualitas clock; batas historis dua menit adalah klasifikasi konservatif, bukan sertifikasi sinkronisasi waktu IED.
Engine ARIEC61850 tetap pin revisi code-trial (PR #192). Stable software bukan klaim interoperabilitas multi-vendor R7/R10 atau paritas SCL/IID tersertifikasi.
Hanya Windows x64; binary belum Authenticode-signed secara komersial. Kontrol IED dan PurgeBuf manual memerlukan izin serta prosedur FAT yang aman.

codeSigning.label: Not Authenticode-signed
codeSigning.detail: The current public Windows installer and portable binaries do not carry a commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verify the published SHA-256 value before use. SmartScreen warnings are therefore possible and are not hidden from users.
codeSigning.detailId: Installer Windows dan portable EXE publik saat ini belum memiliki commercial Authenticode publisher signature. Verifikasi nilai SHA-256 yang dipublikasikan sebelum digunakan. Karena itu peringatan SmartScreen masih mungkin muncul dan status ini tidak disembunyikan dari user.
